描述_EN: the shape of this lobed bowl was derived from similar silver vessels; reproductions in ceramic could have been used as a substitute for precious metals and used in burials. fragments of yue ware have been found in trading-posts in south asia and suggest the existence of a flourishing export market. in the cha jing or 'classic of tea', a work supposedly compiled before the end of the tang dynasty (618-960), yue bowls are regarded as the most appropriate for tea-drinking and their appearance is compared to jade. this stoneware bowl is an example of yue ware with its grey-green celadon glaze.
描述_ZN: the shape of this lobed bowl was derived from similar silver vessels; reproductions in ceramic could have been used as a substitute for precious metals and used in burials. 在南亚的贸易站发现了越窑的碎片，表明存在着一个繁荣的出口市场。 在唐朝末年（618-960）编撰的《茶经》中，越窑碗被认为是最适合饮茶的，其外观被比作玉石。 这个石器碗是越窑的一个例子，它的釉色是灰绿色的青瓷。
